name: Destino
source:
"It was a long, long journey." 

A snowy white demon named Bran. 
An immaculate war angel named Flay. 
It would be nice if it could last forever...

"This is the story of the end of travel..."

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE084167.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“这是一段很长很长的旅程。” 

名叫布兰的雪白恶魔。
一位名叫弗莱（Flay）的完美战争天使。
如果能一直这样就好了……

“这就是旅行终结的故事……”

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE084167.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
